claim_under_pricing: Final cheap check for the rejected C5 spread mechanism: does population spread move the handling-limit feasible boundary when the spread is applied to lateral vehicle channels, specifically center-of-gravity position lf/lr and yaw inertia Iz, rather than to mass/brake/drive/tau? This is a zero-training pricing rider. It reports whether per-vehicle grid tuning buys anything over a once-tuned fixed reflex and over the frozen kappa-RLS classical arm on S0 vs S4L.

seed_discipline.disjointness: selection and validation eval-seed sets are asserted disjoint at runtime; this experiment uses a new seed base disjoint from the S0-S3 C5 pricing base 20260712.

S4L_lateral.mapping: VehicleParams generated by the existing env randomization path with exact per-instance cg_shift_range and inertia_scale_range. Base lf/lr are 1.35/1.45 m with wheelbase held at 2.80 m; sample_vehicle_params clamps lf to [0.9, 1.9] and sets lr = wheelbase - lf. The configured +/-0.42 m range is inside the clamp.

shared.track: circle R=60 m, width 5 m, mu uniform [0.25,1.15] per episode, entry speed friction-capped at 0.92*sqrt(mu*g*R), friction_step disabled, max_steps 480, finish_on_pass true
shared.obstacle_placement: curvature-compensated onto the centerline arc as in c5_prereg.json; per-row pinned v, mu, s_arc, half_width
shared.denominator: primary rates use only rows solved by the reveal-constrained oracle

T_limit.admission: generator label in {aeb_feasible, aes_feasible} AND per-instance adjusted label in {aeb, aes, drift}; adjusted label remains the frozen C5 model and does not include cg/Iz

arms.fixed_v4_incumbent: M3105 v4 reflex verbatim; secondary transfer arm only
arms.fixed_star: one fixed 27-grid config selected on pooled S0 selection rows, both surfaces
arms.v4_rls: same 5 s sub-limit kappa_b/kappa_d familiarization prefix and frozen kappa map as C5; this arm intentionally does not observe or compensate cg/Iz
arms.v4_pertuned: per (level, surface, instance) winner of the 27-point grid on selection rows, validated on fresh rows
arms.oracle: same reveal-constrained privileged search as C5; fixed_star prefix to reveal, then structured candidates and CEM

tuning_grid_27.selection_tiebreak: higher selection success, then fewer hard failures, then fewer multipliers different from 1, then lower grid index

preregistered_readouts.uncertainty: Wilson 95% CI per arm; episode-paired bootstrap CI95 for primary differences; Newcombe MOVER CI also reported
preregistered_readouts.lateral_rider_decision_rule: Report per-cell A1 readouts for S0/T_mid, S0/T_limit, S4L/T_mid, and S4L/T_limit. A cell is marked qualifying if primary_prize >= 0.15, paired-bootstrap CI95 lower bound > 0, and classical_residual >= 0.08. This rider does not by itself stand up C5, admit training, or make a driver-performance claim.
preregistered_readouts.paper_use: If S4L cells do not qualify, the original C5 spread mechanism remains rejected within current-sim expressiveness. If one or more S4L cells qualify, the result only justifies a PI decision on whether to re-price or redesign C5 around lateral spread.

runtime_gates: composed v2+v4 action function must equal the canonical M3105 v4 function exactly on 200 random observations
selection and validation eval-seed sets disjoint
light rollout outcome must match run_episode_with_policy outcome on sampled rows
RLS prefix peak rear utilization must stay below 0.6
budget_and_trim_rule: Full A1 rider is 2 levels x 2 surfaces x 12 instances, roughly half of the original C5 pricing budget; no trimming unless projected wall time exceeds 2.5 h, in which case trim S4L from 12 to 8 instances and keep validation seeds per instance unchanged.
env_expressiveness_limits_declared: Low-fidelity env expresses cg shift and yaw inertia through VehicleParams, but still has no load transfer, tire-curve shape changes, wheel lockup, or season/tire-family dynamics.

Wheelbase classes are not included in this A1 rider because the current config path keeps base wheelbase fixed at 2.80 m while shifting lf/lr. Adding wheelbase classes would require a separate env API change and preregistration.
The per-instance adjusted admission label remains the frozen C5 model and does not incorporate cg/Iz. Oracle filtering remains the primary denominator guard.
claim_boundary: Feasibility-audit pricing rider only. Zero training. No incumbent driver mutation, driver-performance, validation ranking, promotion, high-fidelity sufficiency, paper, repair-success, robustness-result, feasibility-proof, or self-ID claim.
